Agent Name: Tizin_Translation_Expert
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: They misapplied the “is pleasing to” rule for Maktay and assigned roles/cases as in English. In Tizin, the experiencer (“I”) must be the direct object (accusative “Mato”) and “apples” the subject (nominative “Apple”), yielding V–O–S: “Maktay Mato Apple.” Instead, they produced “Maktay Zapple Pa,” incorrectly making “apples” the object and “I” the subject.
